title: A repulsive anode interface for high-energy and safe lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01490E, Paper
Jihoon Oh, Joseph L. Frank, Randolph A. Leising, Heejin Kim, Jisub Kim, Minkwan Kim, Jang Wook Choi
This study focuses on interfacial engineering using tungsten (W), a material immiscible with lithium (Li). The intrinsic immiscibility of W enhances Li metal cohesion, thereby promoting a dense and compact Li deposition layer.
